analyst_view.overall: Second-bottom Elche (11 points from 13 games, one win in five, 1-1 at Levante last Sunday) host third-placed Atlético (31 points, four wins in five). Atlético play Viking at the Metropolitano in the Champions League on Wednesday, so some rotation on Saturday is possible; Lookman is out for about a month with a knee sprain and Cuti Romero is still recovering from a muscle problem, while Pubill is back in training. Elche are without midfielder Marc Aguado (ankle) and right-back Rubén Sánchez (adductor), with Houary, Yago Santiago, Boayar and Revivo doubtful. None of these absences is in the numbers, which already count both sides' low recent scoring; no referee is named yet.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals, already trimmed for both sides scoring little lately (Elche 4 and Atlético 8 in their last six). I lean a little lower: Lookman, one of Atlético's main attackers, is out for about a month and the numbers don't know it, and Elche lose their playmaker Aguado. A mild -3% gives about 2.6.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.2 corners, with Atlético's recent low corner count (25 in six) already counted. A Simeone side with a lead tends to sit back and let the home team push, which can bring Elche corners, but nothing in the news changes that picture. I stay at about 9.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.2 cards, already reflecting Elche's 16 cards in their last six and Atlético's quieter run. No referee has been named yet, and a relegation-threatened home side against a top-three team usually plays with intensity that the numbers already see. I stay at about 4.2.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.6 shots, already lifting Elche (+11%) because Atlético have allowed a lot of shots lately (102 in six). Possible Atlético rotation after Wednesday's game could add to that, but Lookman's absence cuts their own threat, so the two balance out. I stay at about 26.6.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.3 shots on target, already lowering Elche (-6%) for their recent lack of accuracy. With Lookman out for Atlético and Aguado missing from Elche's midfield, both teams lose a creator the numbers still count on, so I lean slightly lower, about 8.1.
